recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-16549; any future conditional-update behavior change should be handled under a separate finalized tracker because the seed behavior and its later refinements are already represented.
issue_request: FHIR-16549 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification for STU3 asking the conditional update no-match text not to imply unconditional create, but instead to point to a new Update as Create subsection and the same CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.updateCreate support flag used for normal update-as-create behavior.
initial_application: Commit 098f965b5694f683ba3d593564f698c031777ef2, "GF#16549 - note about conditional update and create," added the Update as Create subheader in source/http.html and changed the conditional-update no-match bullet from a direct create interaction to an Update as Create reference. The Jira comments cite svn revision 14198, matching that commit.
additional_context: source/http.html is in build scope through publish.ini:295. Later final same-section decisions refine the wording without reversing the seed: FHIR-17906 split no-match/no-id from no-match/id behavior, FHIR-20390 clarified that id means Resource.id, FHIR-26688 removed contradictory ignore-id text, and FHIR-36859 added the existing Resource.id conflict case. FHIR-28495 touched nearby update-as-create If-None-Match guidance but does not change the FHIR-16549 conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active HTTP page already has the Update as Create subsection, the updateCreate support flag, and conditional-update no-match rows saying no Resource.id creates the resource while Resource.id provided with no existing resource is treated as Update as Create or rejected if unsupported.
